liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 other sources): A skip in Jack Straw has been fixed in this transfer [1][2]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (1 review, 1 other source): Lazy Lightnin' into Supplication is called outstanding; Wow and flutter at the start of Lazy Lightnin' has been largely corrected [4][9]
- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): The Sugaree is described as intensely hot and fabulous; Sugaree runs about thirteen minutes with Donna's vocals, and the crowd response suggests it rivals the 12/28/79 version [9][17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): The Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain is singled out as exceptional and reason enough to hear the show; The Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain is called incredibly good [8][9]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Promised Land is highlighted as a song that makes you stop and listen [14]
- **Loser** (1 review): Garcia omits the 'Don't you push me' verse the second time through Loser [12]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain is called breathtaking, with Donna's singing sounding beautiful on it [19]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 other source): A tuning flaw before Ramble On Rose was fixed, and a reel flip occurs in that song [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.83196.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 4.87/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.32305.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.32274.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Disc changes are seamless in this soundboard transfer [3]
- **gd1977-05-11.151619.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Many pops were removed from Set II, and one small Set I patch came from Charlie Miller's soundboard [4]
- **gd77-05-11.sbd.barbella.8374.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 177 min; rated 4.79/5 by 39 [6]. Said about its sound: Mix rated top marks, though the vocals sit slightly distant; The full soundboard SHN copy includes patches, and the reviewer found hearing it complete a revelatory experience [12][15]

## Around the show

- Judged better than the 9th but not as tight as the 7th or 8th [12]
- Called the best show of the month, more cohesive than 5/8, with 5/7 a close second [14]
- The reviewer ranks this Sugaree as a possible tie or winner against 12/28/79 [17]
- The reviewer recommends also getting the Tuscaloosa show played right after this night [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.83196.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]. Also: Levels were adjusted in Cool Edit Pro, disc changes are seamless, and Wharf Rat has a reel flip [1]
- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.32305.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Reel flips occur in Ramble On Rose and Wharf Rat; levels were adjusted in Cool Edit Pro [2]
- **gd1977-05-11.sbd.miller.32274.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [3]. Also: Reel flips occur in Ramble On Rose and Wharf Rat; levels were adjusted in Cool Edit Pro [3]
- **gd1977-05-11.151619.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; tape supplied by Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: Unknown aud (3rd gen cassette) - From the collection of Doug Lamarre (given to him by Dan Liff dec'd) [4]
- **gd77-05-11.sbd.barbella.8374.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: The listener's copy came from a Gans radio broadcast (GDH) [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Mark Slupe: [Grateful Dead May 11, 1977 St. Paul (MN) Civic Center](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/may-11-1977-st-paul-mn-civic-center) [21]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 5/11/77 St. Paul …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27304786531/) [22]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27304786531/) [23]
